brief: a new strand extends from the far end of the RNA primer along the template, closing one rung at a time to the template as it goes, and stops short leaving bare template ahead of it
look: DNA drawn flat and side-on: a continuous blue template backbone along the bottom; above its left-hand part a short green primer, joined to the template by a row of evenly spaced two-colour rungs; the rest of the template bare. The new strand is rose pink and continues the green primer end to end along the same line — never beside it, never below it, never joined to it by a rung.
